description: This PHP script manages the user selection popup in the SuiteCRM module 'Users'. It initializes the environment, builds search and form components, handles user input, and displays a list view of users for selection.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views with data retrieved from the database, supporting templates and multiple selection features.

methods.name: setXTemplate
methods.description: Associates a template object with the ListView to define its layout.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed at the top of the ListView.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the header section of the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Configures the database query parameters, including WHERE clauses and sorting options.

methods.name: setModStrings
methods.description: Assigns localization strings used within the list view for labels and headers.

methods.name: processListViewMulti
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view, supporting multiple selection capabilities.
